decision_gate_for_optional_product_sugge.critical_semantic_error_definition: A mandatory technology, material, application or qualifier from the Russian request is omitted, reversed, or replaced by a different claim in all proposed groups.

interpretation: This checks whether local-model English concept suggestions merit a separate opt-in user trial. Structural validity or literal retrieval counts alone cannot prove relevance or weak-signal detection. No proposal is executed in the working scout flow by this test.
